audit_title: NexSolve P7C Exposure & Vulnerability Input Audit
spatial_framework: Official Survey of India (SoI) Administrative Boundaries (8 NER States, 131 Districts)

datasets.name: NITI Aayog National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)
datasets.limitations: Reflects NFHS-5 sample survey period; 16 focus districts have full disaggregated sub-indicators; state averages cover remaining districts.

datasets.name: BMTPC Vulnerability Atlas of India
datasets.provider: Building Materials & Technology Promotion Council (BMTPC), MoHUA, GoI
datasets.limitations: Housing construction materials are aggregated at district scale.

datasets.name: MoHFW / NHA Health Facility Registry (HFR)
datasets.provider: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) / NHA, GoI
datasets.limitations: Covers registered district civil hospitals & primary health centers; sub-center coverage varies in remote hill blocks.

datasets.name: UDISE+ School & Shelter Infrastructure Database
datasets.provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, GoI
datasets.limitations: Schools are potential emergency shelter infrastructure; not officially designated evacuation centers.

datasets.name: MoRTH / NHAI National Highway GIS Network Registry
datasets.provider: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) / NHAI, GoI
datasets.limitations: Covers National Highway arterial network; state highways and BRO border roads require supplemental layers.

datasets.name: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA)
datasets.provider: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI), GoI
datasets.limitations: Reference year is 2011; decennial census 2021 was delayed. Population numbers reflect 2011 baseline.
